sharedRules: Do not duplicate business identity records across surfaces.
Paid placement must be labeled Sponsored/Featured.
Verification level must be displayed accurately.
Country, age, moderation, availability and commerce rules apply before ranking.
A business can be discoverable even when payments are unavailable, but purchase CTAs must be hidden or disabled where not legally/operationally supported.
HoloLingo translation and HoloAccess accessibility settings should apply across all surfaces.
